contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Coin. Nummus, probably of House of Valentinian, Securitas Rei Publicae issue of 364-378, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Reverse description: Possibly Victory advancing left. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 15.1mm, Weight: 0.94gms, die Axis: possibly 12
